name: Law And Grace
overview: Scripture reveals a clear distinction between law and grace, emphasizing that the law was given through Moses to reveal human guilt and bring conviction, while grace and truth come through Jesus Christ, offering deliverance from the dominion of sin. Believers are no longer under the law but under grace, having died to the law through the body of Christ so that they may serve God in newness of spirit rather than the oldness of the letter. Faith does not nullify the law but rather upholds its true purpose, enabling fruitfulness unto God through a transformed relationship with Christ.
